summary: apm install that retired the last APM entry from a config file APM created left the file behind as an empty skeleton (.mcp.json as {"mcpServers": {}}, .claude/settings.json as {}) and an empty mcp_target_servers lock field; the file now goes when nothing else is in it and the lock omits the empty field, so the result equals a fresh deploy, while a file holding the user's own entries or keys stays.
